title: Bank Rate on 1 January 1919 and on every day it changed, 1919-1931
source: Bank of England, 'A millennium of macroeconomic data for the UK' (version 3.1): sheet 'D1. Official Interest Rates'
series: date (ISO); bank_rate: Bank Rate, per cent, the new rate from that day ('Bank Rate 1833-1972, ...')
license: The workbook asks users to cite the underlying sources ('When using this data, please cite this source'). The Bank of England publishes it as a research dataset; a subset is stored here for teaching, with attribution to the Bank of England.
notes: Workbook SHA-256 4c23dd392a498691eac92659aec283fb43f28118bd80511dc87fc595974195eb. The sheet gives the rate for every day; the snapshot keeps the first day of 1919 and each day on which the rate differs from the day before.
citation: Bank of England, A Millennium of Macroeconomic Data for the UK, v3.1 (R. Thomas and N. Dimsdale, 2017), sheet D1
